about_the_game:
🌍 QUICK TRANSLATE ENGINE

Instant Translation Power in Games, Movies, and Daily Life

Quick Translate Engine is a professional desktop translation tool developed to eliminate all language barriers in the digital world.
Whether you are playing games, watching series, working, or chatting…
Language is no longer a problem for you.

Now supporting both ONLINE and OFFLINE modes, it is with you in every condition.

🔥 NEW: OFFLINE TRANSLATION (OFFLINE MODE)

You can now translate without an internet connection.

✅ Standard Mode – Fast and low resource usage
✅ High Quality Mode – More natural and smart translations
✅ Selective Model Download – Download only the languages you need, avoid unnecessary load
✅ Smart Memory Management – Frees up system RAM when offline mode is off

No internet?
Airplane mode?
Weak connection?
No problem.

🎬 INSTANT SUBTITLE TRANSLATION

Netflix, YouTube, Twitch, offline videos, and in-game cutscenes…

Press a single hotkey, mark the subtitle area.
Quick Translate Engine:

  • Tracks that area live

  • Instantly captures every incoming subtitle

  • Overlays the translation with a stylish and non-blocking layer

🎯 Series, movies, streams, and games are now in your own language.

📸 SCREEN TRANSLATION – OCR TECHNOLOGY

Are there texts you can't select?

In-game menus, images, warnings, PDFs, error messages…

✅ Advanced OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
✅ Bubble and semi-transparent translation layer
✅ Optimized structure for in-game usage

🎮 Say goodbye to games you couldn't play because of language.

🚀 INSTANT TEXT TRANSLATION

For selectable texts:

  • Chat messages

  • Browser texts

  • Documents

  • Emails

With a single key:
Change the language you read
Write your reply in the other person's language
Communicate in real-time

🌐 Great advantage in online game chats.

🧠 MULTI-API SUPPORT

Use ready-made systems or add your own API keys:

  • DeepL

  • Google Translate

  • Microsoft Translator

  • Yandex

  • OpenAI

  • Offline AI

Freedom to choose the most suitable engine for every text type.

⚙️ GAMER AND SYSTEM FRIENDLY

  • Minimum CPU and RAM usage

  • Does not drop FPS

  • Runs silently in the system tray

  • Interface is fully customizable

  • Keyboard shortcuts are completely up to you

✅ Does not disturb during gameplay
✅ An invisible helper in the background

🧑‍💻 WHO IS IT FOR?

✔ Gamers
✔ Series & movie viewers
✔ Software developers
✔ Students
✔ Multilingual professionals

The world is your playground.
Quick Translate Engine is your key.

📌 Note:

Quick Translate Engine supports both online and offline translation modes.
In offline mode, all operations take place on your computer – fast, secure, and requires no internet.

name: Quick Translate Engine

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.0 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card with DirectX 10 support or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: An active internet connection is required for translation features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Whether you instantly translate a movie subtitle, chat with foreign teammates in a game, or understand text in an image. Quick Translate Engine removes any barrier on your screen with a single key.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Korean, Thai, Ukrainian
